modal.help_s1b: Beddel Drive-yada mugga oo dhan, + Ku dar gal si aad u lifaaqdo, x mid ka saaraa, ama ku dheji wadooyin `;` ku kala saaran Wax ka beddel. Beddelashada tabyadu waxay beddeshaa galalka.
modal.help_s2b: Magaca, Regex (hab Rust), Fuzzy, Nuxurka faylka, Glob (*.rs), Mid kasta (OR) / Midna (NOT), cabbirro (bytes ama 10M/1G), taariikho (YYYY-MM-DD), liiska Ka-reebista, Kordhinta ama chip-yada kooxeed (way beddelaan, mar kale riix si aad u nadiifiso; Maamul wuxuu wax ka beddelaa kuwa gaarka ah), Iska indha tir far waaweyn, Muuji qarsoon.
modal.help_s3b: Badhanka weyn ee Baadh & raadi ama Enter. Cusboonaysii waxay dib u orodaa iyadoo doorashada la hayo. Live si toos ah ayay u orodaa wax ka beddelka (wa dansan yahay asal ahaan). Raadin madhan waligeed ma oroddo — * geli Glob wax kasta.
modal.help_s4b: Cinwaannada yaryar ayaa kala sooca, Tag waxay boodaa bogagga, sanduuqyada calaamaduhu waxay quudiyaan Koobiyee wadooyinka / Rar / Tirtir iyo dhoofinta CSV–TXT–HTML–Excel–RTF. Raadin kaydsan iyo Sawirrada dhawaan waxay soo celiyaan filter kasta oo ay ku jiraan galalka, OR/NOT, iyo qarsoon.
modal.help_keys_body: Enter waa raadi · Esc waxay tuurtaa diiradda / xidhaysaa wada-hadallada · ↑/↓ waxay dhaqaajisaa doorashada · Space waxay calaamadeysaa saf · Tab waxay u dhex guurtaa kontaroolada.
